# Copilot instructions for the Bracketway repository

The conventions for this repo live in two files at the root. Read them before changing code:

- `AGENTS.md` — language floor, backend/frontend patterns, migration rules, unit test
  requirements, and verification/deployment hygiene.
- `CLAUDE.md` — commands (build, test, deploy) and architecture.

This file deliberately restates none of it, so there is only one copy to keep current.
